briefings.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026 Keynote (FULL)
briefings.tldr: OpenAI announced over 20 new products and features at DevDay 2026—led by personal autonomous agents called "dots," collaborative workspace "ChatGPT spaces," new frontier models like GPT-6.1 Sol and UltraFast, and cloud-native developer tooling—aiming to transform AI from a conversational assistant into an active, 24/7 collaborative partner.

briefings.title: Builders Unscripted: Ep. 5 - Derya Unutmaz

people.name: Derya Unutmaz
people.role: Immunologist and Professor, The Jackson Laboratory

briefings.tldr: Immunologist Derya Unutmaz leverages advanced AI models like OpenAI's reasoning models and Codex to build custom biological software apps, simulate complex cellular immune responses, and pioneer a future of AI-driven personalized medicine.

briefings.title: Builders Unscripted: Ep. 4 - Pietro Schirano
briefings.tldr: Pietro Schirano, Founder & CEO of MagicPath, showcases how frontier models like GPT-5.5 and Codex serve as "malleable clay" for human-AI collaboration.

briefings.title: Builders Unscripted: Ep. 3 - Matias Castello, Product Leader at Alchemy
briefings.tldr: Matias Castello (Product Lead at Alchemy) leverages Codex and GPT-5.5 to automate the software development lifecycle, proving that non-engineers can build production-ready software by managing AI agents that autonomously research, draft plans, write code, and execute pull requests.

briefings.title: Builders Unscripted: Ep. 2 - Ashe Magalhaes, Founder of Hearth AI
briefings.tldr: Ashe Magalhaes argues that AI is shifting the builder’s role from technical architect to "creative conductor," where agentic workflows enable individuals to build at unprecedented speeds while prioritizing human connection and presence.

briefings.title: Builders Unscripted: Ep. 1 - Peter Steinberger, Creator of OpenClaw
briefings.tldr: Peter Steinberger, creator of OpenClaw, discusses how "agentic engineering" has fundamentally shifted the developer's role from writing syntax to managing intent, enabling a level of productivity where a single builder can maintain over 120 projects and 90,000 annual contributions.
